investigations.name: hypoxia-motility
investigations.description: The showcase study for viva-grammar. The generic GrammarRulesProcess reads the verbatim hypoxia rules and drives the minimal reference substrate. Oxygen is depleted into a central hypoxic core; core cells transition to a motile phenotype (baseline speed 0.47 µm/min) and migrate up the oxygen gradient; the deepest core goes necrotic; late reoxygenation (uptake relief) reverts the motile cells.
investigations.title: Hypoxia → motility (grammar on a reference substrate)
investigations.objective: Does the generic grammar engine, driven by the paper's verbatim hypoxia rules, reproduce the transient post-hypoxic motile phenotype on a minimal reference ABM?
